Project.title: Project
Project.description: Motion graphics project for Flews Motion editor containing canvas configurations and serialized timeline layers.

id.description: Unique identifier of the project document.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

name.description: User assigned title of the motion project.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio tag, such as 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9, 4:3, 21:9, custom.

backgroundColor.description: Hex color code for canvas background.

layersJson.description: JSON serialized timeline layers with keyframes, effects, null objects, text and shapes.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: User motion graphics projects stored under the user UID boundary.
